name: Dock Street
desc1: Dock Street is the last place in town where people seem to be trying
desc2: to go about their normal lives, conducting business and gathering to
desc3: gossip in the local tavern. Some seem to be pretending that nothing
desc4: is amiss, while others gather in corners and whisper fearfully. Like
desc5: all strangers, you are eyeballed with suspicion and unease. To south
